author: TwoBytes
tagline: Catalog your vinyls, CDs, books, films, games and LEGO.
description:
DVinyl is a self-hosted manager for physical collections: vinyls, CDs, books, films, video games and LEGO, with custom item types.

- Add items by ID, barcode scan or bulk import (e.g. a whole Discogs library)
- Automatic metadata from Discogs, Hardcover, TMDB, IGDB and Rebrickable
- Market value estimates for music collections
- Multiple collections and users with admin, editor and viewer roles, optional OIDC SSO
- Modular dashboard, 14 colour themes, 5 languages

tips.before_install: API keys are optional and can be added later from the app settings in ZimaOS. On first launch, open the web UI to create the admin account.

title: DVinyl
release_note: DVinyl 3.2.1: TMDB duplicate checks now tell movies and TV shows apart, Goodreads import fixes.
